name: China Resources Medical Holdings Company Limited
summary: China Resources Medical Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides general healthcare, hospital management, and other hospital-related services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through two segments Hospital and Other Business. The Hospital segment offers out-patient and in-patient business corresponding to self-owned hospitals. The Other Business segment offers operation management services, supply chain services, and other services to participating hospitals and IOT/OT hospitals.
